keyPoints.en: Threats: phishing, viruses, worms, trojans, spyware, ransomware.
keyPoints.bm: Ancaman: pancingan data, virus, cecacing, trojan, perisian intip, perisian tebusan.

keyPoints.en: Protect: strong unique passwords, 2FA, updates, antivirus, backups, never click unknown links.
keyPoints.bm: Perlindungan: kata laluan kuat dan unik, 2FA, kemas kini, antivirus, sandaran, jangan klik pautan tidak dikenali.

tip.en: Report scams to the National Scam Response Centre (997).
tip.bm: Laporkan penipuan kepada Pusat Respons Scam Kebangsaan (997).

keyPoints.en: Your digital footprint is permanent — think before you post.
keyPoints.bm: Jejak digital anda kekal — fikir sebelum memuat naik.

keyPoints.en: Never share IC numbers, addresses or passwords; ask before posting others' photos; report cyberbullying.
keyPoints.bm: Jangan kongsi nombor MyKad, alamat atau kata laluan; minta izin sebelum memuat naik gambar orang lain; laporkan buli siber.

keyPoints.en: Respect copyright: check licences, credit creators, avoid plagiarism.
keyPoints.bm: Hormati hak cipta: semak lesen, nyatakan pencipta, elakkan plagiarisme.

keyPoints.en: Computer Crimes Act 1997 (unauthorised access); Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (personal data).
keyPoints.bm: Akta Jenayah Komputer 1997 (akses tanpa kebenaran); Akta Perlindungan Data Peribadi 2010 (data peribadi).
